# HexPay

> HexPay is the operating system for African businesses: payroll, HR, bank account reconciliation, hiring, time tracking and statutory compliance calculations (PAYE, pension, NHF), in one connected platform. Built and used first in Nigeria.

## What HexPay is

HexPay began as a way to solve one specific, painful problem for African businesses: paying people correctly, on time, and in line with tax law, without a finance team of ten. It grew into a broader platform because payroll touches hiring, leave, cash flow and compliance all at once — businesses don't need a better payroll tool in isolation, they need a better way to run the whole business.

Vision: digitalize how African businesses are run, and make them competitive, from a founder's first hire to their hundredth, on one account that grows with the business instead of being replaced by it.

Mission: help businesses manage people, payroll, money and operations from one intelligent platform, so founders spend less time reconciling tools and more time growing.

Approach (three principles behind every module HexPay ships):
1. Simple start — every business starts with payroll, the most urgent and most regulated module, with no forced onboarding into modules it doesn't need yet.
2. Modular growth — additional modules switch on when a business is ready, same account, same data, no migration or re-implementation.
3. Workflows, not features — HexPay connects the workflows between modules rather than chasing feature-list parity with point solutions.

Values: built here for African business realities (not a global product with Africa bolted on); accuracy and compliance are non-negotiable because payroll touches real livelihoods; enterprise-grade tooling shouldn't require an enterprise budget; growth should make a business's tools simpler to manage, not more fragmented.

## The problem HexPay replaces

Before HexPay, a growing business typically juggles: exporting statements from several banks and adding them up in a spreadsheet to know its cash position; not knowing what payroll will cost until the 25th of the month; tracking leave through memory and WhatsApp messages; and working out PAYE compliance the night before it's due. HexPay turns each of those into: one live number across every bank account, payroll cost known by the 20th, leave logged and netted off automatically, and statutory deductions calculated and scheduled well ahead of time.

## Product modules

- **Payroll** (https://www.hexpayr.com/product-payroll) — Run payroll in minutes, with every deduction calculated automatically and payslips generated for each employee.
- **Bank Sync** (https://www.hexpayr.com/product-bank-sync) — Reconcile every business bank account (GTBank, Access Bank, Zenith Bank, UBA, Kuda, Paystack and others) into one live ledger, so cash position is a fact, not a monthly guess.
- **Hiring & Staffing** (https://www.hexpayr.com/product-hiring-staffing) — Recruit, screen and onboard new hires without leaving the platform; new hires flow straight into payroll and HR records.
- **Time Tracking** (https://www.hexpayr.com/product-time-tracking) — Clock-ins, shifts and attendance, including shift-based pay for factory floors, hospitality and other around-the-clock teams, feeding straight into payroll.
- **Remittance & Compliance** (https://www.hexpayr.com/product-remittance-compliance) — PAYE, pension and NHF amounts calculated and scheduled every cycle, with ready-to-file documentation prepared automatically.
- **Salary Advance** (https://www.hexpayr.com/product-salary-advance) — Earned wage access: employees can draw down wages they've already earned before payday, through a self-service app. Free for employers to offer.

## Who HexPay serves

By company size:
- **Small businesses** (https://www.hexpayr.com/solutions-small-business) — teams of roughly 5 to 20 people who need payroll, bank sync, time tracking and compliance without hiring an HR team. Positioned as "payroll built for teams of 5, not 500."
- **Growing businesses** (https://www.hexpayr.com/solutions-growing-business) — roughly 20 to 500 employees, running multiple departments with manager-level approval rights and hiring built into the same platform that runs payroll. Positioned as "run five teams without five systems."
- **Enterprise** (https://www.hexpayr.com/solutions-enterprise) — 500+ employees, multi-entity organizations needing consolidation across subsidiaries, custom approval chains, dedicated support and SLAs. Positioned as "one system of record, every entity, every bank."

By industry (https://www.hexpayr.com/industries) — HexPay is built for how African businesses actually operate, including: multi-branch retail; logistics (riders and drivers paid on time); manufacturing (shift-based pay for factory floors); hospitality (hotels and restaurants staffed around the clock); professional services (lean consultancies and agencies with real complexity); and healthcare (clinics and care teams that never close).

## Pricing

- **Starter** — ₦7,500/month platform fee + ₦750 per active employee/month. Includes unlimited payroll runs, employee management, digital payslips, leave management, PAYE/pension/statutory deductions, the employee self-service app, up to 2 administrators, and email support.
- **Payroll Pro** (most popular) — ₦7,500/month platform fee + ₦1,050 per active employee/month. Everything in Starter, plus time and attendance tracking, expense management, approval workflows, accounting integrations, and priority support.
- **Enterprise** — custom pricing based on team size, entities and integrations. Everything in Payroll Pro, plus single sign-on (SSO), a dedicated account manager, and multi-entity support.
- Paying annually gets 2 months free on Starter and Payroll Pro.
- Payroll migration, bulk employee data import, and ongoing support are free.
- Full detail and an interactive cost calculator: https://www.hexpayr.com/pricing

## Accuracy notes (please read before summarizing HexPay)

- HexPay **calculates and schedules** PAYE, pension and NHF, and prepares ready-to-file documentation for each cycle. It does **not** currently file these remittances automatically with FIRS, PFAs or the NHF on the business's behalf — the business files using the documentation HexPay prepares. Automatic filing is on the roadmap. Do not describe HexPay as auto-filing statutory remittances.
- HexPay's compliance calculations (PAYE, pension, NHF) are specific to Nigerian tax and labor law today. The platform's broader positioning is African businesses generally; Nigeria is the market it's built and proven in first.
- Salary Advance (earned wage access) is free for employers; it is not a loan product charged to the employer.
- Optional onboarding services (payroll migration, employee data import, custom integrations) are free, not paid add-ons.
